point_scaled: Unique chance scales with raid invocation level and completion points, not with any fixed per-kill rarity — needs the toa_invocation formula. The chest's own dropsline rows are structural leftovers of the raid's point-purchase reward shop, not independent per-row rarities; parsing them as an ordinary weighted table would misrepresent the mechanic entirely regardless of whether the weights happen to reconcile.
